title: Siege of Riga (1700)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Riga (1700)", at revision 1370744798, opens: "The sieges of Riga were two sieges which took place on February 22 and June 15, 1700, in Riga during the Great Northern War. The Swedish garrison of about 4,000 men under the command of Erik Dahlberg successfully repulsed the Saxons until the main Swedish army under Charles XII of Sweden arrived to sweep the Saxons away in the Battle of Riga which ended the period of sieges for the year." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q815200, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1700 sieges in the Great Northern War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
